summary: Release-hardening phase (149O.20L.7O.3L): prepared a frozen, independently-verified v0.4.2 release candidate implementing 3K's selected Option B (ship 3J's already-verified, attachment-only Repository Intelligence integration as a narrow patch, with release language drawing the AUTOMATIC RI CONTEXT ATTACHMENT vs. TRUE RI-BACKED ADVISORY REASONING distinction exactly). Re-confirmed via git diff v0.4.1..HEAD that the only post-v0.4.1 production source change is core/advisory.py's additive, fail-soft, non-authoritative repository_intelligence_context field. Bumped version 0.4.1 -> 0.4.2 in pyproject.toml and src/pcae/__init__.py. Wrote docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V0_4_2.md. Audited README.md/docs for overclaiming RI-reasoning wording -- none found. Froze release_candidate_commit bc7935f4bb86ea7f6ade823a4e63ed9c9cc0a0c4 via pcae commit implementation; confirmed the candidate-drift rule holds (git diff bc7935f4..HEAD -- src/pcae pyproject.toml docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V0_4_2.md empty). Built two independent clean clones (git clone --no-local, detached HEAD at the candidate commit, separate fresh venvs, hatchling==1.32.0 pinned, Python 3.14.5) and produced byte-identical wheel (pcae_harness-0.4.2-py3-none-any.whl, 2,352,007 bytes, sha256:20fce764abe4bebc36c831f11c286db16c516b289e966838c4169c10294b60b4) and sdist (pcae_harness-0.4.2.tar.gz, 2,053,704 bytes, sha256:19f6372447d8a65bf804c41c7ef7fdca501b58d33ec66b5b9365abc2982f0455), verified via both cmp and independent SHA-256 computation. Inspected both artifacts for contamination (.git/.claude/worktrees/private-research/.env/credentials/caches/venvs) -- none found. Installed wheel and sdist into two separate fresh venvs: version 0.4.2 confirmed, import works, CLI works, behavior agrees. From the installed wheel, ran the installed-artifact Advisory Mode RI-attachment smoke against a disposable clone with a freshly generated Repository Intelligence snapshot, without running pcae advisory-context build first: repository_intelligence_context.available == true with provenance and limitations present, confirming no manual CLI prerequisite. Ran missing-RI (snapshot removed: truthful no_repository_intelligence_snapshot_found fail-soft), malformed-RI (garbage JSON: truthful repository_intelligence_context_build_failed fail-soft with no fabricated context), and stale-RI (differing recorded commit: possibly_stale_snapshot limitation attached) smokes -- all passed, no traceback in any case. Verified read-only acquisition via identical SHA-256 of latest.json before/after an advisory-check invocation. Verified authority non-flow by diffing 14 authority-relevant JSON fields (broker_decision, advisory_decision, every would_*, hard_block_present, authorization_granted, execution_authorized, command_executed, enforcement_applied) between RI-present and RI-absent invocations -- all identical. Verified Permission Broker isolation by source inspection (only core/advisory.py changed since v0.4.1; no push/promote/rollback broker code reads Repository Intelligence). Verified manual pcae advisory context build still works unchanged from the installed wheel. Verified pcae runtime inspect unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable) before and after all installed smokes. Ran 3J's 18-test focused suite and 3J.1's 28-test independent suite unweakened: 46/46 passed. Ran Fast Green against both the candidate tree and an independently checked-out pre-phase-baseline clone with matching cwd/rootdir in both runs (a cwd/rootdir mismatch discovered mid-phase in an initial attempt was root-caused and corrected before recording numbers): baseline 336 failed/8567 passed/11 skipped/13 errors; candidate 335 failed/8568 passed/11 skipped/13 errors; node-ID-level diff shows exactly one candidate-only failure (the expected, self-referential test_head_equals_origin_main tripwire, which resolves on push and is not source-caused) and zero attributable regressions. F1 (symlink/provenance hardening) and F2 (attachment-not-reasoning) carried forward unrepaired, correctly classified non-blocking for attachment-only v0.4.2 and must-repair-before-true-reasoning-consumption, respectively. Blocker table: BLOCKING = 0, MUST-FIX = 0; deferred items (F1 repair, true RI-backed Advisory reasoning, 115W contract amendment, real AdvisoryProvider connection, Candidate A, Candidate B) explicitly out of scope. No publication performed: no v0.4.2 tag created or pushed, no GitHub Release created, no PyPI upload. Article remains STOPPED; ~/repos/pcae-deepseek-research untouched, out of scope, not inspected. Human publication authorization required before 149O.20L.7O.3L.1; not begun.
